reuse.why: Every server and client consumer, including the new API field, keeps calling the existing shared getScheduledAmount, and the approximate tolerance reuses getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules.

duplication.why: The worst-case rule is written once in getScheduledAmount; call sites only pass the amount and its operator.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the API mapping in api-models.ts and handler types in api-handlers.ts, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: Focused on the amount rule, the API field, docs and tests, with one incidental import reordering in schedules/app.ts.

maintainability.why: Single definition with an explicit op parameter and the template-only rounding variant removed; inserting op before the positional inverse boolean is a small API wart, and useScheduleEdit still calls the helper without op.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains the op parameter (and loses the rangeRounding special case); all call sites route through it
